incoming.problem: collection.ts does not typecheck under strict mode with @decky/ui 4.16.x. GetCollection returns `CCollection | null` (collectionstore.d.ts:271). AsDragDropCollection returns `CCollectionBase | null` (:213), and CCollectionBase has no AddApps, RemoveApps or Save; those are on CCollection (:237-242). The `name` passed to NewUnsavedCollection is never defined, and `plan` is an Envelope, not a CollectionPlan.
incoming.fix: Use a module-level `let name = "3D Ready"` (collection.rs:8). Then `const id = collectionStore.GetCollectionIDByUserTag(name); const c = (id ? collectionStore.GetCollection(id) : null) ?? collectionStore.NewUnsavedCollection(name, undefined as unknown as Parameters<typeof collectionStore.NewUnsavedCollection>[1], []);` and `cur = Array.from(c.apps).join(",")` (apps is a Set<number>). Then `r = await engine<CollectionPlan>("collection","--current",cur)`; if `!r.ok` return null, otherwise `name = r.data.name`. Call `c.AddApps(ov(add))`, `c.RemoveApps(ov(remove))` and `await c.Save()` on the CCollection, only when add.length + remove.length > 0, then return r.data. Drop AsDragDropCollection. Update the inline facts to match.
